cohort: The study included 75 patients with seasonal allergic conjunctivitis and 71 control subjects without SAC diagnosis who were admitted to the Abant Izzet Baysal University Medical Faculty Ophthalmology Clinic.
finding: Patients with seasonal allergic conjunctivitis had a history of prenatal maternal paracetamol exposure and shorter duration of postnatal vitamin D supplementation.
mod_finding: No significant correlation was found between seasonal allergic conjunctivitis and the mode of delivery.
